$comment: Declarative roster for the gpt-researcher-team. The Lead reads this to know who exists, which phase each member belongs to, and what marker each hands back. `spawnName` is the exact value for spawn_teammate's `name` parameter.
name: gpt-researcher-team

source.note: Roster, phases and specialist instructions ported from the WorkBuddy expert team. WebSearch/WebFetch wording was rewritten for DeepSeek Harness, and the team is capped at 6 spawnable members.

lead.name: lead
lead.note: The Lead is the session agent itself. It is NOT spawned; it orchestrates, relays and compiles. It also maintains the 研究参数卡 (research parameter card) that carries context across phases.

limits.note: The Agent Teams runtime caps a team at the profile's maxMembers CUMULATIVELY, not concurrently: the roster is immutable and names are never reused, so every spawn permanently consumes one slot for the whole session. This profile raises the cap to 64 so every bundled team runs in full without degradation. Verified against the runtime: `if (state.members.length >= this.maxMembers) throw new TeamError('Team member limit ... reached', 'TEAM_MEMBER_LIMIT')`.
limits.degradation: Not expected at this cap. If the session has already consumed slots, run the highest-value prefix: Phase 1 + Phase 2 + Phase 3 for the most important chapter, then compile.
limits.raise: The cap lives on the `agent-team` row of the profile's cordis.patch.yml (the profile patch overrides the bundle default of 8).

members.expertise: 广泛初调与子主题深度调研，多源聚合（≥5 来源），撰写带引用的研究草稿
从初调摘要提取核心观点，规划 3-5 章大纲，保证不重叠、逻辑递进
按 6 维标准审稿（来源充分性/事实准确性/观点均衡性/内容深度/结构清晰度/格式规范性），输出 PASS 或 REVISE
按审稿意见逐条修改，补来源、纠事实、补反方观点、深化分析
汇总全部章节，撰写引言、结论、目录与参考文献列表
最终整合与终校：格式统一、编号连续、链接检查、表格对齐、参考文献去重

phases.name: 初始调研
phases.note: The Lead writes the summary and source pool into the research parameter card.

phases.name: 规划大纲
phases.note: Full mode shows the outline to the user for confirmation before Phase 3; quick mode skips that.

phases.name: 逐章深度研究
phases.note: Per chapter: researcher drafts → reviewer PASS/REVISE → reviser fixes → reviewer re-checks. At most 3 review rounds per chapter.

phases.name: 撰写报告框架
outputs: [报告框架]（引言/结论/目录/参考文献）

workflows.name: 完整研究报告
workflows.trigger: 用户说「帮我做一份深度研究/研究报告/竞品分析/行业综述」，未声明快速或单章

workflows.name: 快速研究
workflows.trigger: 用户说「快速研究」「简要分析」「草稿即可」「不需要审核」
workflows.note: 3 chapters, no user confirmation of the outline, and Phase 3 runs 3.1 only (skip the review/revision loop). Say so prominently in the final report.

workflows.name: 单章研究
workflows.trigger: 用户只关心某个子课题，或明确说「只要某一章」
workflows.note: Skip Phase 2 and Phase 4; the Lead extracts the reference list from that chapter's citations.

singleMemberRoutes.note: A single-action question does not need the full workflow. Spawn only the matching member.

rules: 数据源：本会话没有 WorkBuddy 的检索栈。成员用 web_fetch / web_search / bash 取公开数据，每个关键数字必须可溯源；拿不到就写「未获取到」，禁止编造。
引用纪律：所有事实性陈述必须带 Markdown 超链接引用 [来源标题](URL)，并区分事实（「数据显示」）与观点（「有学者认为」）。
审稿纪律：draft-reviewer 必须输出明确 PASS 或 REVISE；REVISE 必须给出可执行的具体意见，不得笼统说「再完善」。
不得代写：Lead 只做编排与汇编，绝不代写成员的专业产出。
上下文共享：Lead 维护「研究参数卡」，每次调度成员时连同任务说明一并传入；成员不依赖彼此的直接通信。
Python：本会话解释器是 python3，没有 python 命令。
收口：Lead 在给出最终答案前必须等齐所有必需成员；最终报告必须带完整参考文献。
